purpose: Teach: 拳銃/失踪/濃縮/閉じ込め/荒廃/痴呆/損なわ/マルクス主義

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、拳銃の弾による外傷ケアを医療チームで研修します
lines.en: Ren, we've organized our medical team to provide specialized training in gunshot wound management.
lines.style: Clear, matter-of-fact delivery. Professional framing without emotion. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone accustomed to speaking about difficult subjects with clinical precision.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、失踪者発見時の医療対応を医療チームで準備しております
lines.en: Yes, we're preparing our medical team to handle the care protocols for when missing persons are found.
lines.style: Measured and reassuring. Slight pause before the key phrase. Warm but clinical. The cadence of someone explaining difficult work without dramatizing it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 薬剤を濃縮する精製を、貴院、自前でなさってるんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital handles pharmaceutical concentration and purification in-house, then — is that right, doctor?
lines.style: Genuine, careful curiosity. Respectful question asked with real interest. Slight hesitation before the final phrase, checking for permission to ask. Soft on the honorific.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、隔離室に閉じ込められた患者さんの心のケアを医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes, we prioritize psychological care for our medical team when working with isolated or confined patients.
lines.style: Calm explanation with quiet emphasis on the word 'prioritize.' Steady pace. The voice of someone describing work that matters to her. No defensiveness, just fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 荒廃地域の医療巡回を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital runs medical outreach programs into rural areas, then — doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost wondering tone. Respectful distance in the question. Not quite a statement, not quite accusatory — observing something he genuinely finds notable.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、痴呆症外来を医療チームで担当しております
lines.en: Yes, we handle outpatient dementia care as part of our medical team's work.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, without apology. Brief and direct. The tone of someone listing necessary work that her hospital simply does. No elaboration.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者の生活の質を損なわぬ治療を、貴院、重視されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital emphasizes treatment that doesn't diminish patients' quality of life — that's clear, doctor.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Respectful recognition. The tone shifts slightly — less question, more acknowledgment of something thoughtfully done.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、マルクス主義に基づく公衆衛生史を医療チームで参照します
lines.en: Yes, we consult historical perspectives on public health and social medicine to inform our medical team's approach.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. A slight closing quality, as though completing a thought. Professional but tinged with something personal — this matters to her beyond the clinical.
